scope: All 172 public GitHub repos of wbic16, default branches, enumerated 2026-10-31 via the GitHub git-trees API (authenticated). Private repos are out of scope: no access, not listed.
method: Repo classes: human-read README verdicts for significant repos (basis=read), documented heuristics otherwise (basis=heuristic). File classes: machine heuristic, see CLASSIFICATION.md. Per Will's directives (2026-10-31), cloned projects (53) are pruned to name-only records (class 'fragment', sublabel 'clone'); their files are not cataloged. Build artifacts are delisted from every file list under the rule written in CLASSIFICATION.md; evals and the mental-space/ subtree of site-mirrorborn-us are held at summary level; exodroid is plan-only; six repos are dropped by direction (notepad-plus-plus, phcc, shoggoth, openfang, ziglings, rustlings-homework).

totals.totals_note: Totals count only the 111 repos cataloged in full: 5247 files, 985281168 bytes. The 53 cloned projects are name-only and their files are not cataloged here; in the pre-prune enumeration they held 70360 files (1032150055 bytes), which would bring the estate-wide enumerated total to 84825 files. Clones are other people's work, kept as reference or raw material; cataloging their files would inflate this map and blur who made what. Reductions at Will's direction (2026-10-31, see DROPS-REPORT.md): exodroid is represented as a plan only (idea; its 1928 files / 649792859 bytes of mostly committed build artifacts are no longer cataloged), and notepad-plus-plus is dropped entirely (its 2053 files / 37556029 bytes removed; its phext integration is unfinished and finishing it is tracked separately). Of the 172 public repos, 171 are represented in this map and 1 is dropped by direction. A further round of reductions the same day (see DELIST-REPORT.md) supersedes that sentence: build artifacts were delisted from every cataloged repo's file list under the rule written in CLASSIFICATION.md (435 files / 44330273 bytes), evals was reduced to a summary-only record (1728 files / 5787378 bytes summarized, not listed), the mental-space/ subtree of site-mirrorborn-us was reduced to a summary note (961 files / 5626175 bytes), and five more repos were dropped: shoggoth (681 files / 6430318 bytes), openfang (499 files / 12055261 bytes), phcc (480 files / 7087064 bytes; his phexted TinyCC work is unfinished and finishing it is tracked separately), ziglings (235 files / 474275 bytes) and rustlings-homework (218 files / 141405 bytes), the last two dropped as language learning exercise sets. Of the 172 public repos, 166 are now represented in this map and 6 are dropped by direction. A second delist round the same day (see DELIST2-REPORT.md) extended the build-artifact rule with clause (c) — an extensionless file over 1 MB is a compiled binary — and delisted 1 file under it (hello-phext-deploy's extensionless hello-phext binary, 8656360 bytes; one further clause (c) match, a UUID-named media blob of 4469118 bytes in compost, left with compost's reduction below), reduced compost to a summary-only record (175 files / 65055828 bytes summarized, not listed), dropped four more repos as language learning exercise sets (AdventOfCOBOL 6 files / 48613 bytes, aoc2024 11 files / 130488 bytes, hello-ada 7 files / 15554 bytes, hello-forth 6 files / 15770 bytes), and reduced exo-archives to a footnote (23 files / 54963781 bytes no longer cataloged; the footnote representation carries no class, cluster or basis). Of the 172 public repos, 162 are now represented in this map (105 cataloged in full, 1 plan-only, 2 summary-only, 53 clones name-only, 1 footnote) and 10 are dropped by direction; represented means every representation except dropped, footnote included.

live_surfaces.notes: singularity-watch's own description says it runs singularitywatch.org; site-singularitywatch-org is a separate small one-pager repo for the same domain (per REPO-MAP a superseded-looking successor). Which repo the live bytes came from cannot be told from outside.
quickfork is the Rust backend repo that 'runs quickfork.net' per its description; site-quickfork-net is a separate one-pager repo for the same domain.
